records.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: original production reference sheet for a 14-panel action webtoon pilot. Sophisticated clean original color-comic drawing: confident tapered charcoal outlines, expressive mature adult faces, economical coherent shapes, two or three deliberate shadow values, matte colors, restrained material texture, clear hands and adult body proportions. No copied character, franchise design, named-artist imitation, real likeness, childlike proportions, photorealism, glossy 3D or decorative fantasy clutter. Warm cream sheet background. No lettering, labels, logos or watermarks. This sheet is design evidence, not a comic page. Primary request: one coherent model sheet of Nera, a fictional 31-year-old woman courier. Mature long face, short tightly curled black hair, medium warm brown skin, steady dark eyes, subtly tired adult expression. Lean athletic adult build, narrow shoulders, pale muted yellow asymmetrical short rain cape fastened at right collarbone over charcoal fitted practical tunic and trousers, simple dark ankle boots. Small empty chest sling for one medicine flask. Plain straight dark wooden short staff, no blades or ornaments. Three full-body front/profile/back turnarounds aligned at same scale along upper two-thirds; six clearly adult face closeups below showing calm focus, doubt, alarm, resolve, pain and quiet relief. Consistent exact clothes/cape fastening/hair across views. Include one isolated natural hand gripping the staff. Wide landscape sheet, precise uncluttered spacing, no cut-off feet. Outfit practical, fully clothed, nonsexualized.
